situation (example wording): "Robberies by weapon in Texas in 2024", any breakdown by weapon, and a single-weapon question such as "robberies with a handgun".
what the app does today: The canonical offense_weapon segment keeps the weapon code and its automatic flag in two columns (weapon, weapon_automatic). A weapon breakdown groups on the weapon column alone, so 12A is counted in the Handgun row, 11A in Firearm (type not stated), 13A in Rifle; there is no separate (Automatic) row. A single-weapon filter on the plain code (handgun = 12) includes the automatic ones; a filter on a 3-character code matches weapon plus flag (compile.ts weaponIn).
proposed behavior: A weapon recorded with the automatic flag counts in the same row as the plain code: 12A in Handgun, 11A in Firearm (type not stated), 13A in Rifle (and 14A in Shotgun, 15A in Other Firearm by the same rule). The flag is not a separate row.
exact default or choices offered: Rows by the plain weapon code; the automatic flag is ignored for grouping.
